subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The __lavish__ party had a luxurious atmosphere and elegant decorations.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Excessive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lavish"** means something that is extravagant, luxurious, or excessive in spending or use. (बहुत अधिक, खर्चीला, या विलासितापूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** The hotel offered a lavish breakfast buffet with an array of gourmet dishes.
 
 
 
• **"Excessive"** refers to something that exceeds the normal or necessary limits; too much of something. (अत्यधिक)
 
 
• **Example:** The excessive use of plastic is harmful to the environment.
 
 
 
• Both "lavish" and "excessive" share a similar connotation of something being more than usual or necessary, hence they are synonyms.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Excessive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Simple** (साधारण): Something that is plain, not elaborate, or easy to understand.

 
 
• **Example:** She wore a simple dress to the party.
 
 
 
• **Happy** (खुश): A state of being joyful or content.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt happy after receiving the good news.
 
 
 
• **Middling** (औसत): Something that is moderate in quality, neither very good nor very bad.
 
 
• **Example:** His performance in the exam was middling.
